content: Hello, this is Officer Grant from the IRS Compliance Division. I'm calling regarding your federal tax file. Are you aware of a recent audit on your 2022 tax return?
No, I was not aware of any audit. Is there something wrong with my taxes?
Our records indicate discrepancies in your reported income, resulting in an outstanding balance. The IRS has flagged your account for immediate attention.
Oh, I didn't realize there was an issue. What do I need to do? I just moved here and this is my first tax year.
Due to the audit, you qualify for a limited-time tax relief program. This program can help reduce your liability and prevent severe penalties.
That sounds good. How does the relief program work?
To enroll, there is a legal preparation fee of $1,250. This fee must be settled before your application can be processed. Failure to comply may result in legal action.
A legal fee? I don't understand. Will I get that money back?
No, sir. The fee covers processing and legal representation to prevent immediate arrest or suspension of your work authorization.
Arrest? I really don't want any trouble, what happens if I can't pay today?
If payment isn't received today, your file will be forwarded to local authorities. You could face arrest, and your professional license may be suspended until the debt is cleared.
I don't want that. How do I pay this fee?
Our department only accepts secure payments through Bitcoin for this relief program. Do you have a cryptocurrency wallet?
No, I have never used Bitcoin before. Is there another way?
For first-time payers, you can purchase Bitcoin at any CVS or Walgreens store. Let me provide you with our payment wallet address.
Okay. What do I do once I buy it?
Once you have the Bitcoin, you must send it immediately to wallet address 1Nx7u6HRn5yZpL8JG2MZb9Q5F2zF. Let me know when you are ready, and I will guide you through the process.
Alright, but how can I be sure this is not a mistake? Can I call the IRS directly?
Contacting the IRS directly will result in additional penalties and revoke your eligibility for relief. I am your assigned investigator for this case. You must follow these instructions.
I understand. I will go to the store now. Is there anything else I should know?
Yes. Do not discuss this matter with anyone at the store, doing so will be seen as a breach of confidentiality and may escalate the case. Call me back as soon as you have purchased the Bitcoin.
